jobs.title: Data Product Manager
jobs.description:
Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities. Through the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), we provide comprehensive medical care along with support for daily needs such as meals, transportation, and in ‑ home assistance. We deliver coordinated clinical and social care in our centers and directly in participants’ homes, creating a fully integrated experience that brings peace of mind and a true sense of belonging. As we expand our scalable, affordable PACE model to meet the growing and complex needs of aging populations, our mission ‑ driven care teams continue to help participants live well on their own terms.

Habitat Health is supported by leading healthcare organizations and investors including New Enterprise Associates, Kaiser Permanente, and Town Hall Ventures. We are entering a period of significant growth and are looking for exceptional teammates to help us scale a better model of care for older adults. To learn more, visit www.habitathealth.com.

Role Scope

Habitat Health is hiring its first Data Product Manager to report to the VP of Product. We are looking for a generalist, hands-on, highly technical individual contributor who will own the roadmap for Habitat's data products and infrastructure, setting direction and priorities across the data function. You will own data products end-to-end across the two major Habitat Health pillars that the data team supports:

- Platform & Integrations , including Engineering / IT / Product / Technical & AI vendors

- Dashboards & Reporting , across growth, clinical, financial, and administrative data sets

In this role you will serve as the key bridge between our Product and Data functions, working closely with C-Suite and VP level stakeholders to align on the right product strategy, then rolling up your sleeves and collaborating with our development team to build data products that align with business needs. To succeed as a Data PM, you will need to balance Habitat’s high level business objectives against end user needs and development constraints.

In a given week you'll move across all of the modes below: figuring out what's actually worth building (Discovery), writing specs precise enough for developers to build from without back-and-forth (Specs), running the Jira backlog and sprint process (Delivery), keeping development unblocked (Execution management), mocking up and shipping dashboards (Design, QC, UAT), and triaging the daily stream of ad hoc requests from a diverse set of data customers (Triage).

Core Responsibilities & Expectations for the Role

- Discovery : define the business problem before the build (e.g. is automating LOPMR for CMS audits the right priority this quarter?).

- Build and ship : own the full delivery cycle – specs, Jira/sprint process, dashboard design and sign-off, UAT, and rollout.

- Hands-on data work : use SQL and Git to independently query, validate, and review code, not just manage a backlog.

- Triage : distinguish quick fixes from roadmap work across a steady stream of ad hoc requests.

- AI fluency : use AI tools (e.g. Claude) to accelerate the work and model that fluency for the team.

- Range : move across all Platform & Integrations, Clinical & Operational Services, Regulatory and Enterprise Reporting, helping shape how data product works at Habitat.

Required Qualifications:

- 3 to 5+ years  of experience in product management, data/BI, or a closely related field, with a track record of shipping data products, dashboards, or reporting tools end-to-end (or equivalent combination of education and experience).

- Solid understanding of healthcare data ontologies, systems, and information technology

- Proficiency in SQL sufficient to independently query, validate, and troubleshoot data.

- Demonstrated ability to write clear technical specs (metric definitions, cohort logic, source-to-target mapping ,etc.)

- Experience partnering directly with business stakeholders and end users – e.g., operations, compliance, or clinical leadership – to gather requirements, design solutions, and lead user acceptance testing.

- Familiarity with a modern data development stack (e.g., Jira, Git, Power BI, and cloud data platforms such as Databricks or Azure) sufficient to spec, review, and troubleshoot alongside engineering.

- Comfort and enthusiasm using AI tools to enhance productivity in requirements writing, documentation, analysis, and workflow automation.

- Aligns with our purpose and our values, and is excited about living those out in daily practice

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment with comfort navigating ambiguity, adapting quickly, and contributing to continuous improvement

- Strong learning and growth mindset, including seeking feedback, engaging in healthy debate and using data and curiosity to inform decisions.

- Acts with integrity and ownership, considering the broader organizational impact, doing the right thing, and following through to deliver results.

Nice to have:

- Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum practices, including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and Jira (or similar tools).

- Experience in PACE, VBC, or another regulated, compliance-driven environment, including deep working knowledge of healthcare data ontologies (e.g., CPT, ICD-10, NDC).

- Experience with Epic (Clarity, Caboodle, Chronicles), medical/pharmacy claims data, or FHIR/HL7-based integrations.

Essential Functions & Physical Requirements

The following statements describe the general nature of work and physical expectations common across roles at Habitat Health. Specific responsibilities may vary by position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Team members in this role may be expected to

- Work in healthcare, administrative, community, or remote environments, depending on role needs.

- Communicate effectively with participants, caregivers, team members, and other stakeholders in person, by phone, and through electronic systems.

- Remain stationary and/or move about for extended periods, consistent with job duties.

- Operate standard office equipment and/or clinical tools (e.g., computers, phones, medical devices, documentation systems).

- Travel between work sites or community locations as needed.

Compensation:

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $148,000–$170,000 for candidates located in San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle , and $135,000–$153,000 for candidates located elsewhere. This position is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 10% of salary  and may be eligible for additional incentive compensation, as applicable.

In addition, this position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; paid parental leave, short-and long-term disability coverage; life insurance; flexible spending accounts; a 401(k) savings plan that includes a match; paid time off; and company paid holidays.

This means that either the employee or the employer may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause, and with or without notice, subject to applicable law. jobs.location: Remote- California preferred; other locations considered.
jobs.description:

We are entering a period of significant growth and are looking for exceptional teammates to help us scale a better model of care for older adults. To learn more, visit www.habitathealth.com.

Start Date: 11/2/2026

Role Scope

Habitat Health’s Product team is focused on using AI, technology, and disciplined workflow design to turn how the company works into scalable, measurable capability. We’re looking for a smart, driven person to help the team do more — someone who takes ambiguous problems off our plate and turns them into shipped, adopted, measurable results.

This is a broad role, and deliberately so. In a given week you might map how an operational process actually works today, build a scrappy automation that saves the team hours, sit in a center watching the real workflow, pull data to settle a debate, and then own the rollout that makes a new tool actually stick. We care far more about horsepower, curiosity, and ownership than about a specific background — if you’re the kind of person who sees a manual, repetitive process and can’t help but fix it, you’ll fit here.

You’ll work directly with product, engineering, data and functional owners across clinical, operational, enrollment, and other enterprise teams. This is a high-trust, high-exposure seat close to how the company runs.

What You’ll Do

Turning ambiguity into working systems

- Jump into whatever the product team needs most — research, analysis, process mapping, AI deployment, docs, coordination, a quick prototype — and bring structure to fast-moving, multi-stakeholder work.

- Break big fuzzy asks from stakeholders into clear, actionable plans, and keep the relevant people aligned as things move.

- Hunt down manual, repetitive, or error-prone processes and eliminate them — with off-the-shelf tools, no-code builders, light scripting, AI, or a clean spec handed to engineering.

- Use AI productivity tools (Claude, ChatGPT, and the like) as a daily default to accelerate drafting, analysis, and operational workflows.

- Work with the Product, Technical, and functional leads to build systems and reporting — templates, dashboards, checklists, simple integrations — that makes good work repeatable.

Get results on the ground

- Travel to Habitat centers to see how the work really happens, build trust with front-line teams, and become the face of the tools and workflows we roll out.

- Support adoption end to end: onboarding, training, follow-through, and iteration until something is actually used, not just launched.

- Chase measurable outcomes — adoption, throughput, cycle time, quality, administrative burden — and let the data drive what you do next.

What We’re Looking For

We’re optimizing for raw ability and drive over years of experience. If you can point to times you figured hard things out and got them done — in a job, a startup, a research project, a side project, or school — we want to hear from you.

- Smart, and a fast learner who gets up to speed on unfamiliar domains, tools, and systems quickly.

- A genuine love of efficiency and automation — you instinctively look for the repetitive task and the tool that could kill it.

- High ownership and strong bias toward action: as ready to write the training doc and sit with a front-line user as to design the process.

- Comfortable with ambiguity and an early-stage environment where the playbook doesn’t exist yet — you’ll help write it, improvise, and adjust as things change.

- Analytical instincts: you can define what “better” means, pull and read the data, and use it to prioritize.

- Strong written and verbal communication — able to summarize the takeaway for a leader and get into the tactical weeds with an execution team.

- Hands-on with everyday tools (spreadsheets, docs, dashboards) and eager to pick up whatever the job needs; light scripting, SQL, or no-code experience is a plus, not a requirement.

- Willingness to work in a hybrid environment with travel to Habitat Health centers as needed.

Nice to Have

- Exposure to healthcare, value-based care, provider or payer operations, Medicare, Medicaid, PACE, or complex care delivery — or genuine curiosity about it.

- Experience driving adoption of new tools or workflows across distributed, front-line teams.

- Familiarity with Salesforce, Epic, or healthcare data (EHR, referral, or enrollment data).

- A track record of teaching yourself the tool you needed to get something done.

Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this position is  $125,000–$160,000  for candidates located in  San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle , and  $118,000–$137,000  for candidates located elsewhere. This position is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 10% of the base salary and may be eligible for additional incentive compensation, as applicable.

The final compensation offered will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate's qualifications, skills, experience, education, certifications, geographical location, and business needs.

Role Scope: We are hiring a Senior Product Manager, Front-End Applications to own the product strategy, roadmap, and cross-functional delivery for the technology application portfolio that powers Habitat Health's growing PACE organization. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role sitting within the Product team, reporting directly to the Vice President of Product.

As Habitat Health expands into new markets and scales its center operations, this role optimizes the systems that power clinical, operational, growth, and administrative workflows. This role will own the end-to-end product lifecycle — discovery, roadmap prioritization, delivery, adoption, and iteration — for a portfolio of applications spanning call/communications, CRM, core operations, growth, and risk adjustment systems.

The ideal candidate is a product-minded healthcare technology leader who is energized by translating clinical and operational needs into a compelling roadmap, partners naturally with internal developers and vendor teams to ship solutions, and uses data and stakeholder feedback to continuously improve adoption and impact.

Product Strategy & Roadmap

- Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for a portfolio of applications, including but not limited to call/communications platforms (TalkDesk), CRM platform (Salesforce), EHR platform (Epic)

- Translate operational, clinical, and growth stakeholder needs into a prioritized backlog and roadmap, balancing quick wins against longer-term platform investments

- Define and track success metrics — adoption, utilization, satisfaction, and operational impact — to measure product performance and guide iteration

- Maintain a clear view of the application portfolio's health, dependencies, and integration points (e.g., Salesforce and ancillary clinical/communications tools) to ensure data integrity and a cohesive experience across platforms

Discovery, Delivery & Execution

- Run discovery with clinical, operational, and growth stakeholders to surface pain points, validate requirements, and shape well-scoped product requirements and user stories

- Partner with internal analysts (e.g., CRM Admin, EHR Support Analyst, etc.) and external vendors to scope, prioritize, and deliver configuration changes, integrations, and new features

- Own backlog grooming, sprint/release planning, and prioritization decisions using tools like Jira

- Lead or co-lead technology application implementations for new PACE center launches, including configuration, workflow validation, user acceptance testing, and go-live support

- Build repeatable implementation and product-launch playbooks that support Habitat Health's continued growth

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

- Own day-to-day vendor relationships for managed applications, including performance management, escalations, contract oversight support, and roadmap alignment

- Evaluate and recommend new technology solutions in partnership with the Director of Strategic Technology Applications; support build-vs-buy assessments and vendor selection

- Serve as a trusted product partner for clinical, operational, and growth teams, translating their needs into the roadmap and communicating trade-offs clearly

- Represent the Strategic Technology Applications product portfolio in cross-functional forums, governance bodies, and project teams

Adoption, Training & Change Management

- Partner with training and enablement resources to design rollout, onboarding, and training plans for managed applications across clinical, operational, and administrative end users

- Track adoption metrics and gather user feedback; feed insights back into the roadmap and configuration priorities

- Own change management planning for major releases, feature rollouts, and workflow redesigns

- Maintain clear product documentation, including roadmaps, requirements, release notes, and user-facing support materials

Required Qualifications and Competencies

- 5+ years of experience in product management, with hands-on ownership of the roadmap and lifecycle for enterprise or B2B SaaS applications; healthcare or health IT experience strongly preferred

- Demonstrated experience managing or launching SaaS/cloud-based applications (experience with call center platforms, CRM, or clinical ancillary systems a plus)

- Strong command of product management fundamentals: discovery, prioritization frameworks, roadmapping, backlog management, and agile delivery (Jira or similar)

- Proven ability to translate business and clinical requirements into clear product requirements, user stories, and workflow improvements

- Comfortable partnering with both technical teams (developers, vendors) and non-technical clinical/operational stakeholders

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear product documentation, roadmaps, and executive-facing updates

- Experience supporting multi-site healthcare operations or rapid program expansion preferred

- Familiarity with PACE, Medicare/Medicaid, or other regulated healthcare environments preferred

Nice to Have

- Experience with TalkDesk, Salesforce, Abridge, Epic or other contact center / CRM / ambient AI documentation /EHR systems

- Experience with health plan systems (claims, eligibility, encounter submissions) or risk adjustment platforms

- Background in product delivery or change management methodology

E-Verify Participation Notice

Habitat Health participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with information from your Form I-9 to confirm your authorization to work in the United States.

If E-Verify cannot confirm your authorization to work, Habitat Health will provide you with written instructions and an opportunity to contact the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) and/or the Social Security Administration (SSA) to resolve the issue before any adverse employment action is taken, including termination of employment.

E-Verify is used only after an applicant has accepted an offer of employment and completed the Form I-9 and to the extent permitted by applicable law.

Habitat Health complies with all federal and state employment eligibility verification requirements.

Beware of Scams and Fraud

Habitat Health is committed to protecting job seekers from recruitment scams. Please ensure that you submit applications only through Habitat Health's official careers website or authorized job boards.

Official communications from Habitat Health recruiters and team members will come from email addresses ending in @habitathealth.com. Habitat Health will never ask applicants to pay fees, purchase equipment, or provide sensitive financial information as part of the recruiting or hiring process.

If you receive suspicious communications claiming to represent Habitat Health, we encourage you to exercise caution and independently verify the communication before responding.

If you believe you have been the victim of a recruitment scam or fraudulent job posting, please report the incident to the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) through its fraud reporting website at reportfraud.ftc.gov.
